meta.title: José Chaparro | Backend & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

hero.lead: I build backend systems and run the infrastructure they live on. Today I own the microservices architecture at Moneta Market and co-found the software studio Bifrost Code.

about.heading: About me
about.p1: Software engineer with {years}+ years of production experience building backend-heavy systems in Python and .NET, deploying cloud infrastructure on AWS, and shipping cross-platform applications.
about.p2: At Moneta Market I own the microservices architecture: a six-container production platform wiring together ML pipelines, event-driven webhooks and a C# desktop app. In parallel I co-founded Bifrost Code, a studio that ships full-stack products and self-hosts them on its own infrastructure.
about.location: Chihuahua, Mexico · Available for backend and infrastructure work

experience.heading: Experience
experience.monetaB1: Architected and shipped the company's first containerized platform: a six-service Docker Compose stack (two FastAPI microservices, Label Studio, MLflow and an Nginx reverse proxy) on AWS EC2, with private networking and automated health checks.
experience.monetaB2: Designed the PostgreSQL schema the whole operation rests on: 25 tables on AWS RDS with 24 foreign keys, 34 strategic indexes, an idempotent migration system and soft-delete audit trail; access runs exclusively through an SSH tunnel via an EC2 bastion host.
experience.monetaB3: Built an event-driven FastAPI webhook service linking Label Studio to S3: Repository pattern, atomic database/S3 rollback on any failure, async connection pooling and an in-memory cache with database fallback.
experience.monetaB4: Developed a cross-platform C# desktop app (.NET 10 with Avalonia, migrated off a Windows-only WPF build) for human review of model-labelled frames: MVVM architecture, two-pass verification workflow and a sliding-window prefetch cache.
experience.monetaB5: Implemented least-privilege IAM policies and moved credentials into AWS Secrets Manager; LocalStack emulates S3 locally so development never touches production credentials.
experience.monetaB6: Built the data pipeline's operator tooling — CLIs, idempotent S3-to-PostgreSQL sync, drift audits — and automated model training through GitLab CI on ephemeral AWS GPU instances with MLflow tracking; prototyped edge inference on NVIDIA Jetson (YOLO on TensorRT).
experience.contractorB1: Deliver full-stack web applications end to end with React, Next.js, NestJS and Express, on TypeScript pnpm monorepos backed by PostgreSQL; earlier engagements shipped on React Native, FastAPI and Django.
experience.contractorB2: Three products shipped and still running for real clients: FisioApp (multi-tenant clinic management, audited against WCAG 2.1 AA), Feriu (multi-tenant shared-expense platform) and Karaoke Balu (real-time requests over SSE with kiosk mode).
experience.contractorB3: Self-host client applications on the studio's own infrastructure: a Proxmox VM running Ubuntu Server with Dokploy and Docker Compose, DNS on Cloudflare and services exposed through Cloudflare Tunnels without a single inbound port — a low-cost alternative to Vercel or AWS.
experience.rogaB1: Maintained and extended the internal ERP running across more than 170 branches and used by over 1,750 employees (Mueblería El Pasito / Villarreal Muebles / Dinexpress); built the multi-branch inventory, pricing, accounts receivable and point-of-sale modules in .NET Framework.
experience.rogaB2: Designed the SQL Server database architecture behind multi-branch retail operations: stored procedures for inventory aggregation and pricing logic, plus automated report generation and email delivery through SQL Server Agent.
experience.rogaB3: Standardised security practice across the development lifecycle: a shared password manager for credential handling, physical security keys, and formalised development processes the team still follows.

projects.heading: Projects
projects.scDesc: Full-stack system with cloud infrastructure, RESTful APIs and an integrated machine-learning pipeline.
projects.fisioDesc: Multi-tenant management for physiotherapy clinics: clinical records, appointments, packages and payments. Audited against WCAG 2.1 AA, with automated off-site backups.
projects.feriuDesc: Multi-tenant, self-hosted shared-expense platform with a Splitwise-style settlement engine, built as a NestJS + Next.js pnpm monorepo on PostgreSQL.
projects.karaokeDesc: Real-time karaoke request platform for live events: an SSE-synced queue, admin panel, self-serve kiosk mode and Virtual DJ integration. Express + React monorepo.
projects.sdDesc: Custom dataset training for personalised image generation, exploring fine-tuning techniques for deep learning models.
projects.galagaDesc: Unreal Engine game controlled through a smartphone accelerometer, bridged with Processing and HTTP requests.
